en.s: Zhuge Dan (died 10 April 258), courtesy name Gongxiu, was a Chinese military general and politician of the state of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period of China. When he held key military appointments throughout his middle to late career, he was involved in all of the three rebellions which broke out in Shouchun (around present-day Shou County, Anhui) between 251 and 258.

en.t: The settlement of Villa Imperial de Carlos V (now the city of Potosí) in Bolivia is founded after the discovery of huge silver deposits in the area
en.s: Potosí, known as Villa Imperial de Potosí in the colonial period, is the capital city and a municipality of the Department of Potosí in Bolivia. It is one of the highest cities in the world at a nominal 4,067 m (13,343 ft). Diego Huallpa, an indigenous prospector, is traditionally credited with the discovery of the Cerro Rico in 1545, which led to the founding and rapid growth of Potosí due to its extraordinary silver wealth.

en.s: The Capture of Geertruidenberg of 1589, also known as the English betrayal of Geertruidenberg, took place on April 10, 1589, at Geertruidenberg, Duchy of Brabant, Flanders (present-day the Netherlands), during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604). On April 10, 1589, the garrison of Geertruidenberg, composed by a large number of English and some Dutch troops commanded by Governor Sir John Wingfield, surrendered the city to the Army of Flanders led by Don Alexander Farnese, Governor-General of the Spanish Netherlands (Spanish: Alejandro Farnesio).

en.s: Erfreut euch, ihr Herzen (Rejoice, you hearts), BWV 66.2, BWV 66, is a church cantata for Easter by Johann Sebastian Bach. It was the first battle of the new Prussian King Frederick II, in which both sides made numerous military blunders. Frederick fled the battlefield, but the Prussian Army managed to attain victory. This battle cemented Frederick's authority over the newly conquered territory of Silesia and gave him valuable military experience.

en.s: The Battle of Voltri was an engagement occurring on 10 April 1796 during the French Revolutionary Wars and taking place in Voltri, a suburb of Genoa, Italy. The battle saw two Habsburg Austrian columns under the overall direction of Johann Peter Beaulieu attack a reinforced French brigade under Jean-Baptiste Cervoni. After a skirmish lasting several hours, the Austrians forced Cervoni to withdraw west along the coast to Savona. Voltri is now part of the western suburbs of the major Italian port of Genoa. Voltri was the opening action of the Montenotte Campaign, part of the War of the First Coalition.

en.s: The War of the Fifth Coalition was a European conflict in 1809 that was part of the Napoleonic Wars and the Coalition Wars. The main conflict took place in Central Europe between the Austrian Empire of Francis I and Napoleon's French Empire. The French were supported by their client states—the Kingdom of Italy, the Confederation of the Rhine and the Duchy of Warsaw. Austria was supported by the Fifth Coalition which included the United Kingdom, Portugal, Spain, and the Kingdoms of Sardinia and Sicily, although the latter two took no part in the fighting. By the start of 1809 much of the French army was committed to the Peninsular War against Britain, Spain and Portugal. After France withdrew 108,000 soldiers from Germany, Austria attacked France to seek the recovery of territories lost in the 1803–1806 War of the Third Coalition. The Austrians hoped Prussia would support them, having recently been defeated by France, but Prussia chose to remain neutral. Archduke Charles carried out major reforms to the Imperial Austrian Army, but the quality of it was diminished to some extent by the incompleteness of training and the Army's multinational nature. The French military relied on their talented emperor, veterans, whose numbers had dwindled over the course of recent wars, as well as the effective Napoleonic la maraude tactics. Napoleon, like the Austrians, had to cope with a multinational army, which included many foreign allies. On 10 April 1809, Austrian forces under Archduke Charles crossed the border of Bavaria, a French client state.

zh.s: 第五次反法同盟战争是1809年欧洲的一场冲突，属于拿破仑战争和反法同盟战争的一部分。主要战事发生在中欧，交战双方是弗朗茨一世统治下的奥地利帝国和拿破仑的法兰西帝国。法国的附庸国意大利王国、莱茵邦联和华沙公国给予法国支持。英国、葡萄牙、西班牙、撒丁王国和西西里王国组成第五次反法同盟支持奥地利，但后两国没有参战。1809年初，法军大多投入对抗英国、西班牙和葡萄牙的半岛战争。法国从德国撤回10.8万名士兵后，奥地利进攻法国，试图收复1803至1806年第三次反法同盟战争中失去的领土。奥地利希望刚被法国击败的普鲁士提供支持，但普鲁士选择保持中立。卡尔大公对奥地利帝国军队进行了重大改革，但训练尚未完成，加上军队由多个民族组成，战斗力因此有所削弱。法军依靠善于指挥的皇帝、近年战争中人数有所减少的老兵，以及有效的拿破仑式就地筹粮战术。拿破仑和奥地利人一样，也要统率一支包括许多外国盟友的多国部队。1809年4月10日，卡尔大公率领奥军越过巴伐利亚边境；巴伐利亚当时是法国的附庸国。

en.s: The Battle of Toulouse (10 April 1814) was one of the final battles of the Napoleonic Wars, four days after Napoleon's surrender of the French Empire to the nations of the Sixth Coalition. Having pushed the demoralised and disintegrating French Imperial armies out of Spain in a difficult campaign the previous autumn, the Allied British-Portuguese and Spanish army under the Marquess of Wellington pursued the war into southern France in the spring of 1814. Toulouse, the regional capital, proved stoutly defended by Marshal Soult. One British and two Spanish divisions were badly mauled in bloody fighting on 10 April, with Allied losses exceeding French casualties by 1,400.

zh.s: 1814年4月10日的图卢兹之战是拿破仑战争最后几场战役之一。四天前，拿破仑已代表法兰西帝国向第六次反法同盟各国投降。前一年秋天，威灵顿侯爵率领英国、葡萄牙和西班牙联军，经过艰苦作战，将士气低落、逐渐瓦解的法兰西帝国军队赶出西班牙；1814年春，联军又将战火推进法国南部。苏尔特元帅坚守当地首府图卢兹。4月10日的激战中，一个英军师和两个西班牙师遭受重创，联军伤亡比法军多1400人。

en.s: The siege of Metz (17 January – 10 April 1814) was a blockade of the French city of Metz during the War of the Sixth Coalition at the end of the Napoleonic Wars. It pitted French forces under General of Division (GD) Pierre François Joseph Durutte against Prussian soldiers under Prince Wilhelm of Prussia, Russian cavalry under Nikolay Borozdin, Russian troops under Dimitri Mikhailovich Youzefovitch, and Hessian soldiers under von Müller.

en.s: Field Marshal Arthur Wellesley, 1st Duke of Wellington (né Wesley; 1 May 1769 – 14 September 1852), was a British Army officer and statesman. en.s: Mount Tambora, or Tomboro, is an active stratovolcano in West Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia. Located on Sumbawa in the Lesser Sunda Islands, volcanism is the result of subduction zones. The 1815 eruption was the largest in recorded history, erupting up to 150 cubic kilometers of volcanic material, making it a VEI-7 on the Volcanic Explosivity Index.

zh.s: 1815年4月10日晚，今天印度尼西亚境内的坦博拉火山猛烈喷发，火山碎屑流冲毁周边村庄。坦博拉位于小巽他群岛松巴哇岛的西努沙登加拉省，是一座仍活跃的复式火山，其活动源于板块俯冲。1815年的喷发是有记录以来最大的一次，喷出多达约150立方公里火山物质，火山爆发指数达7级。

en.s: The Greek War of Independence, also known as the Greek Revolution or the Greek Revolution of 1821, was a successful war of independence fought by Greek revolutionaries against the Ottoman Empire from 1821 to 1829. In 1826, the Greeks were assisted by the British Empire, the Kingdom of France, and the Russian Empire, while the Ottomans were aided by their vassals, especially by the Eyalet of Egypt.

The Ottomans had already tried and failed to capture the city in 1822 and 1823, but returned in 1825 with a stronger force of infantry and a stronger navy supporting the infantry.

zh.s: 第三次迈索隆吉围城战发生于希腊独立战争期间，持续于1825年4月15日至1826年4月10日，交战双方为奥斯曼帝国与希腊起义军。这次围城常被误称为第二次围城。奥斯曼军队此前于1822年和1823年两度试图攻占该城，均未成功；1825年，他们带着更强大的步兵和提供支援的海军再次进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Mayals (Spanish pronunciation: [majals]) in Catalonia was fought in the afternoon of April 10, 1834 between a Carlist force led by Manuel Carnicer Griñón and a Liberal force led by José Carratalá near the town of Mayals. The Liberal victory negatively affected Carlism's spread in the region in the early stages of the war.

zh.s: 马亚尔斯之战于1834年4月10日下午在加泰罗尼亚马亚尔斯镇附近展开，交战双方是曼努埃尔·卡尔尼塞尔·格里尼翁率领的卡洛斯派军队与何塞·卡拉塔拉率领的自由派军队。自由派获胜，在战争早期阻碍了卡洛斯派在当地的发展。

en.s: The Battle of Vác, fought on 10 April 1849, was one of the two important battles which took place in the same city in the Spring Campaign of the Hungarian War of Independence from 1848–1849, fought between the Habsburg Empire and the Hungarian Revolutionary Army. This battle was the starting point of the second phase of the Spring Campaign, which had the purpose to relieve the fortress of Komárom from the imperial siege, and with this to encircle the Habsburg imperial forces headquartered in the Hungarian capitals of Buda and Pest.

zh.s: 1849年4月10日的瓦茨之战，是1848年至1849年匈牙利独立战争春季攻势期间，在瓦茨发生的两场重要战斗之一，交战双方为哈布斯堡帝国与匈牙利革命军。此战标志着春季攻势第二阶段开始。这一阶段旨在解除帝国军队对科马罗姆要塞的围困，并进而包围以匈牙利首府布达和佩斯为总部的哈布斯堡帝国军队。

zh.s: 美国防止虐待动物协会（ASPCA）是一家致力于防止虐待动物的非营利组织。该协会自1866年成立以来一直设在纽约市，使命是“为全美防止虐待动物提供有效手段”。

zh.t: 教宗良十三世批准建立美国天主教大学
zh.s: 教宗良十三世（意大利语：Leone XIII；原名若阿金诺·文森佐·拉斐尔·路易吉·佩奇；1810年3月2日—1903年7月20日）是天主教会领袖，1878年至1903年在位。他的任期是历任教宗中第四长，也是在可核实的教宗任期中第三长，仅次于圣伯多禄、前任教宗庇护九世和若望·保禄二世。

en.s: The 1895 election of the Speaker of the House of Commons occurred on 10 April 1895, following the retirement of the previous Speaker Arthur Wellesley Peel. The election resulted in the election of Liberal MP William Court Gully by the narrow margin of 11 votes. It was the first contested Speaker election since 27 May 1839. The next contested election would not be for another 56 years, until 31 October 1951.

en.s: The 1897 FA Cup final was contested by Aston Villa and Everton at Crystal Palace. Aston Villa won 3–2, with goals by John Campbell, Fred Wheldon and Jimmy Crabtree. Everton's goals came from Jack Bell and Dickie Boyle. With results elsewhere going their way, Villa confirmed their status as League champions on this day. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Germany (including recently annexed Austria) on 10 April 1938. They were the final elections to the Reichstag during Nazi rule and took the form of a single-question referendum asking whether voters approved of a single list of Nazi and 11 pro-Nazi "guest" candidates for the 814-member Reichstag, as well as the recent annexation of Austria.

en.s: The Battle of Midtskogen was the battle fought on the night between 9 and 10 April 1940 during the Second World War between a German raiding party and an improvised Norwegian force. The site of the battle was Midtskogen farm, situated approximately 5 km (3.1 mi) west of the town Elverum at the mouth of the Østerdalen valley in southern Norway. The invading German troops were out on a raid to capture the Norwegian King, Haakon VII, and his cabinet and thereby forcing Norway into submission. After a short battle, the German force withdrew, having lost its commander in the fighting.

zh.s: 米茨科根之战发生于第二次世界大战期间的1940年4月9日夜至10日凌晨，交战双方是一支德军突袭部队与临时组织的挪威部队。战场在挪威南部厄斯特达伦谷口的米茨科根农场，位于埃尔沃吕姆镇以西约5公里（3.1英里）。入侵的德军企图俘获挪威国王哈康七世及其内阁，迫使挪威屈服。短暂交战后，德军指挥官战死，部队随即撤退。

en.t: World War II: The Axis powers establish the Independent State of Croatia
en.s: The Independent State of Croatia (Croatian: Nezavisna Država Hrvatska, NDH) was a World War II–era quasi-state. It was a protectorate of Fascist Italy from 1941 to 1943, and a puppet state of Nazi Germany from 1941 to 1945. It was established in parts of occupied Yugoslavia on 10 April 1941, after the invasion of the country by the Axis powers.

en.t: The TEV Wahine, a New Zealand ferry, sinks in Wellington harbour due to a fierce storm – the strongest winds ever in Wellington. Out of the 734 people on board, fifty-three died
en.s: TEV Wahine was a twin-screw, turbo-electric, roll-on/roll-off passenger ferry. Ordered in 1964, the vessel was built by the Fairfield Shipbuilding and Engineering Company, in Govan, Glasgow, Scotland for the Union Steam Ship Company's Wellington-Lyttelton Steamer Express Service in New Zealand. The Wahine began transporting passengers on day and overnight trips on New Zealand's inter-island route between the ports of Wellington and Lyttelton in 1966.

zh.s: Wahine号是一艘双螺旋桨涡轮电力驱动的滚装客轮。该船于1964年订购，由苏格兰格拉斯哥戈万的费尔菲尔德造船工程公司为新西兰联合轮船公司建造，服务于惠灵顿—利特尔顿特快轮渡航线。1966年起，Wahine号开始在新西兰两座港口之间的岛际航线上提供日间和夜间客运服务。

en.s: General elections were held in Rhodesia on 10 April 1970. They were the first elections to take place under the revised, republican constitution. The country had declared itself independent in November 1965, shortly after the previous elections; the Rhodesian Front government had always disliked the 1961 constitution and made sure to change it by the time of the next one.

en.s: Sir James Paul McCartney (born 18 June 1942) is an English musician and songwriter. He gained global fame with the Beatles, for whom he was the bassist and keyboardist, and shared primary songwriting and lead vocal duties with John Lennon. zh.s: 詹姆斯·保罗·麦卡特尼爵士（生于1942年6月18日）是英国音乐家和词曲作者。他凭借披头士乐队享誉全球，担任乐队贝斯手和键盘手，并与约翰·列侬共同承担主要歌曲创作和主唱工作。麦卡特尼以旋律感鲜明的贝斯演奏、多变的男高音音域和广泛的音乐风格闻名，涉猎从早期摇滚乐前流行音乐到古典、民谣和电子乐等多种类型。

The treaty's full name is the Convention on the Prohibition of the Development, Production and Stockpiling of Bacteriological (Biological) and Toxin Weapons and on their Destruction.

en.s: Invicta International Airlines Flight 435 (IM435) was a Vickers Vanguard 952, flying from Bristol Lulsgate to Basel-Mulhouse, which crashed into a forested hillside near Hochwald, Switzerland on 10 April 1973. en.s: The Barin uprising (also known by other names) was an armed conflict between Uyghur militants and Chinese government forces from 4 to 10 April 1990 in the township of Barin (or Baren) in Xinjiang, China. Violence began on the evening of 4 April, when a group of 200 to 300 Uyghur men attempted to breach the gates of the local government office in a protest against forced abortions of Uyghur women and Chinese rule in Xinjiang.

en.s: The Moby Prince disaster was a major naval accident resulting in 140 deaths. It occurred in the late evening of Wednesday 10 April 1991, in the harbor of Livorno, Italy. It is the worst disaster in the Italian merchant navy since World War II. It is also considered one of the two worst environmental disasters in Italian history, along with the explosion and loss of the tanker Amoco Milford Haven on the following day in an unrelated accident near Voltri. MV Moby Prince, a ferry owned by Navigazione Arcipelago Maddalenino (NAVARMA) Lines collided with the oil tanker Agip Abruzzo, sparking an extensive fire that ravaged the ship.

zh.s: “莫比王子”号海难于1991年4月10日星期三深夜发生在意大利利沃诺港，造成140人死亡，是意大利商船自第二次世界大战以来最严重的灾难。它也被认为是意大利历史上最严重的两起环境灾难之一，另一起是次日在沃尔特里附近发生、与本事故无关的“阿莫科米尔福德港”号油轮爆炸沉没事故。马达莱纳群岛航运公司（NAVARMA）旗下渡轮“莫比王子”号与“阿吉普阿布鲁佐”号油轮相撞，引发大火，火势吞噬了渡轮。

en.s: The Good Friday Agreement (GFA) or Belfast Agreement (Irish: Comhaontú Aoine an Chéasta or Irish: Comhaontú Bhéal Feirste; Ulster-Scots: Guid Friday Greeance or Bilfawst Greeance) was a major political development in the Northern Ireland peace process of the 1990s. Northern Ireland's present devolved system of government is based on the agreement. The agreement also created a number of institutions between Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland, and between the Republic of Ireland and the United Kingdom. The agreement is made up of two inter-related documents, both agreed in Belfast on Good Friday, 10 April 1998: 1. * a multi-party agreement by most of Northern Ireland's political parties; 2. * an international agreement between the British and Irish governments (the British-Irish Agreement).

zh.s: 《耶稣受难日协议》又称《贝尔法斯特协议》，是20世纪90年代北爱尔兰和平进程的一项重大政治成果。北爱尔兰现行的地方自治政府制度以该协议为基础。协议还设立了北爱尔兰与爱尔兰共和国之间，以及爱尔兰共和国与英国之间的一些合作机构。协议由两份相互关联的文件组成，均于1998年4月10日耶稣受难日在贝尔法斯特达成：一份是北爱尔兰大多数政党达成的多党协议，另一份是英国与爱尔兰两国政府签订的国际协议，即《英爱协议》。

en.s: In the 2006 Italian general election for the two Chambers of the 'Parliament of Italy' was held on 9 April and 10 April 2006. The incumbent Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi, leader of the centre-right House of Freedoms, was narrowly defeated by Romano Prodi, leader of the centre-left The Union. en.s: A general election for the Constituent Assembly was held in Nepal on 10 April 2008 after having been postponed from earlier dates of 7 June 2007 and 22 November 2007. The Nepalese Constituent Assembly will draft a new constitution; it will therefore decide, amongst other things, on the issue of federalism. The number of eligible voters was around 17.5 million. The Constituent Assembly will have a term of two years. The Unified Communist Party of Nepal (Maoist), or CPN (M), placed first in the election with 220 out of 575 elected seats, and became the largest party in the Constituent Assembly.

en.s: The 2016 Afghanistan earthquake was a magnitude 6.6 earthquake which struck 39 km (24 mi) west-southwest of Ashkasham on April 10, at a depth of 210.4 km (130.7 mi). The shock had a maximum intensity of V (Moderate). The earthquake killed at least 5 people in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province and one in Gilgit Baltistan. A further 46 people were injured in both provinces.

zh.s: 2016年4月10日，阿富汗阿什卡尚西偏南39公里处发生6.6级地震，震源深度为210.4公里。震中烈度最高为V级（中等）。地震在巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省造成至少5人死亡，在吉尔吉特-巴尔蒂斯坦地区造成1人死亡；两地另有46人受伤。

en.s: Long Beach, California, held an election for mayor on April 10, 2018. It saw the reelection of Dr. Robert Garcia. Since Garcia won a majority in the first round, no runoff was needed. Turnout was low, at 15.1%. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan.

Businessman Paul TenHaken, the founder of a local digital marketing firm, placed first in the primary, winning 34 percent of the vote.

en.s: The Clausura 2019 Copa MX final was the final of the Clausura 2019 Copa MX, the fourteenth edition of the Copa MX under its current format and 81st overall organized by the Mexican Football Federation, the governing body of association football in Mexico. The final was contested in a single-leg format between Ascenso MX club Juárez and Liga MX club América. The match was hosted by Juárez at Estadio Olímpico Benito Juárez in Ciudad Juárez on 10 April 2019.

zh.s: 2019年墨西哥杯春季赛决赛是该届赛事的最后一场比赛。这是采用当时赛制以来的第14届墨西哥杯，也是负责管理墨西哥足球的墨西哥足球协会举办的第81届杯赛。决赛采用单场制，由墨西哥次级联赛的华雷斯队对阵墨西哥顶级联赛的美洲队。比赛于2019年4月10日在华雷斯城的贝尼托·华雷斯奥林匹克体育场举行，华雷斯队坐镇主场。

en.t: The Event Horizon Telescope Collaboration announced its first results in six simultaneous press conferences worldwide on April 10, 2019
en.s: The Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) is a telescope array consisting of a global network of radio telescopes. The EHT project combines data from several very-long-baseline interferometry (VLBI) stations around Earth, which form a combined array with an angular resolution sufficient to observe objects the size of a supermassive black hole's event horizon.

zh.t: 事件视界望远镜合作组织在全球六地同步新闻发布会上公布首批成果
zh.s: 事件视界望远镜（EHT）是由全球射电望远镜组成的阵列。EHT项目结合地球各地甚长基线干涉测量站的数据，形成一套角分辨率足以观测超大质量黑洞事件视界尺度天体的阵列。

en.s: On April 10, 2021, fighters from the Ta'ang National Liberation Army (TNLA) and Myanmar National Democratic Alliance Army (MNDAA) attacked a police station controlled by Tatmadaw, killing fourteen police officers. The Naungmon ambush was the first attack by the Three Brotherhood Alliance during the Myanmar civil war and after the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état.

zh.s: 2021年4月10日，德昂民族解放军和缅甸民族民主同盟军武装人员袭击了一座由缅甸军方控制的警察局，造成14名警察死亡。瑙蒙伏击是缅甸内战期间、2021年缅甸政变后，三兄弟联盟发动的首次袭击。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the disputed territory of South Ossetia on 10 April 2022. As none of the presidential nominees obtained at least 50% of the votes, a runoff was held on 8 May 2022, between the top two candidates, Alan Gagloev and incumbent president Anatoly Bibilov. Prior to the run-off, Gagloyev received endorsements from the three candidates eliminated in the first round, Alexandr Pliyev, Garri Muldarov, and Dmitry Tasoyev, heading into the runoff against incumbent president Anatoly Bibilov.

zh.s: 2022年4月10日，存在争议的南奥塞梯地区举行总统选举。没有候选人获得至少50%的选票，因此于5月8日举行决选，由阿兰·加格洛耶夫对阵时任总统阿纳托利·比比洛夫。决选前，首轮被淘汰的三名候选人亚历山大·普利耶夫、加里·穆尔达罗夫和德米特里·塔索耶夫都表态支持加格洛耶夫。

Incumbent Governor Takatoshi Nishiwaki was re-elected for a second term, defeating Ken Kajikawa with 66.81% of the vote.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in France on 10 and 24 April 2022. As no candidate won a majority in the first round, a runoff was held, in which incumbent Emmanuel Macron defeated Marine Le Pen and was re-elected as President of France. Macron, from La République En Marche! (LREM), had defeated Le Pen, leader of the National Rally, once already in the 2017 French presidential election, for the term which expired on 13 May 2022.

en.s: On April 10, 2023, a mass shooting occurred at an Old National Bank branch in Louisville, Kentucky, United States. Five people were killed, and eight others were injured, including two responding police officers. The shooter, 25-year-old former employee Connor James Sturgeon, was fatally shot by police at the scene.

en.s: Legislative elections were held in South Korea on 10 April 2024. All 300 members of the National Assembly were elected, 254 from first-past-the-post constituencies and 46 from proportional party lists. The two largest parties, the liberal Democratic Party and the conservative People Power Party, once again set up satellite parties to take advantage of the electoral system.

zh.s: 韩国于2024年4月10日举行国会选举，选出全部300名议员。其中254人由单一选区以得票最多者当选的方式产生，46人按政党名单比例代表制产生。两大政党——自由派的共同民主党和保守派的国民力量党——再次组建附属政党，以利用选举制度争取更多席位。

en.s: On early 10 April 2024, Ambazonian separatist rebels of the Bui Unity Warriors attacked the base of the Cameroonian Rapid Intervention Battalion in Kumbo, resulting a battle that lasted for hours. Several insurgents and at least one Cameroonian soldier were killed. After the rebel main force had retreated from the town, Cameroonian security forces conducted raids and revenge attacks in and around Kumbo in response to the initial attack.

en.s: The 2024 Tasmanian Labor Party leadership election was held on 10 April 2024 to elect a new leader of the Tasmanian Labor Party. The election was triggered by the resignation of Rebecca White after Labor lost the Tasmanian state election, the third consecutive loss under her leadership and fourth consecutive loss overall. Dean Winter of the Labor Right faction was elected unopposed.
